title: Balanced parentheses: one ( on the stack per open one
notes: q1 means nothing is open. The first ( goes on top of $ and moves to q2; every ( pushes one more, every ) pops one, and when $ is back on top an ε-move returns to q1, which accepts. Every move pops what it expects, so the machine is deterministic. On ()) the last ) finds $ on top and has no move.
